label: What the manifest must say
subgoals: List region structure, dimension and sigma range in the manifest
Return an interval, effective sample size and call count with the estimate
Match the design's failure structure against the advertised support

label: Where each change lands
subgoals: Place the weight and estimator code in the immutable core
Place new proposal distributions behind the sampler seam as plug-ins
Place sigma target, budget and confidence level in configuration

label: Golden statistical tests
subgoals: Build limit states with exact known failure probabilities
Assert interval coverage across many seeds
Compare a new variant with the baseline within combined intervals on a reference cell
